templateVmid.title: Template vmid
templateVmid.description: The LXC template each chat's container is linked-cloned from (see the README for how to build one).

pool.title: Resource pool
pool.description: Containers are created in this pool; the API token's permissions are scoped to it.

bridge.title: Network bridge
bridge.description: Containers get DHCP on this bridge.

idleStopMinutes.title: Stop after idle (minutes)
idleStopMinutes.description: Minutes after the chat goes idle before its container is stopped (it restarts on the next command). 0 stops at once; -1 never stops.

destroyUnusedDays.title: Destroy after unused (days)
destroyUnusedDays.description: A container no terminal has used for this many days is destroyed, even if its chat still exists (e.g. it went back to local terminals). The next remote terminal makes a fresh one. 0 keeps it until the chat is deleted.

sshKeyPath.title: SSH private key file
sshKeyPath.description: Path on the Dispatch host, e.g. ~/.ssh/dispatch_proxmox_terminal. Used when the PROXMOX_TERMINAL_SSH_KEY secret is not set. PROXMOX_TERMINAL_SSH_PASSWORD works instead of (or as well as) a key.

workDir.title: Pre-0.2 checkout directory on the container
workDir.description: Only used to rescue checkouts made before 0.2 into your local repository. Since 0.2 the checkout is remote-host's.

templateHostKey.title: Template SSH host key
templateHostKey.description: The template's ed25519 host key fingerprint (SHA256:…, from `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub` on it), which every linked clone shares; remote-host pins it. Moving to a new template with its own key? List both, separated by a space, until the old template's clones are gone. Password logins need it. Leave empty to trust whatever answers at the address the Proxmox API gives (Settings → Proxmox containers warns).

spawnTimeoutSeconds.title: Provisioning timeout (seconds)
spawnTimeoutSeconds.description: How long Dispatch waits for a container before refusing the terminal (it never falls back to a local shell).

caCert.title: Proxmox CA certificate (PEM)
caCert.description: Paste /etc/pve/pve-root-ca.pem to verify the node's self-signed certificate properly.

insecureTls.title: Skip TLS verification
insecureTls.description: Only if you cannot supply the CA certificate. The API token travels in every request.
